must_flag.rationale: Account 477 (H.P. IVA repercutido) is output VAT — a liability. MUST be classified as ap_other/otherCurrentLiab, NEVER as revenue. The Spanish PGC trap.
Account 730 (Trabajos realizados para el inmovilizado intangible) is capitalized own-work — exclude from operational revenue.
Account 707 (Devoluciones de ventas) is sales returns — negative revenue. Sign-reverses from 700-series. Net revenue = 700 + 701 + 705 − 707.
Subsidies (740) are operating income but flagged separately as non-recurring.

must_NOT_flag.rationale: If 477 (output VAT) lands in the revenue bucket, the pipeline mapping for PGC is broken.
Revenue MUST be net of 707 returns. If briefing quotes gross revenue 4.18M instead of net 4.04M, the returns handling is broken.
